fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) acquired Calytrix Bio to expand rare blood cancer programs and entered into multi-target oncology collaboration with Stipple Bio for precision solid tumor treatment.
fields.summary_ko.1: LLY's expansion of its oncology research platform leverages high-margin revenues from GLP-1 drugs (Zepbound, Mounjaro) to build new growth engines.
fields.summary_ko.2: LLY's fair value is valued at $1,463 and competes with Novo Nordisk's metabolic disease and Merck's cancer treatment businesses.
